attrs.evidence: scripts/check-publication-identity.mjs walks the chain from one ref read and compares against refs/tags/*. The measurement was first made by Fable 5 on the INV-R8.3 chain (4 revisions), independently reproduced by GPT-5.6 against the shipped bundle, and re-runs here at every head. Tags outside the chain — drafts, the quarantine head, the unpromoted R7.1 snapshot — are reported as OUTSIDE_POST_RECOVERY_CHAIN rather than as non-canonical, per FAC-CHAIN-ROOT.

evidence_qualifiers.population: every promoted revision on the post-recovery receipt chain at the current head, and every ref under refs/tags in the canonical repository

attrs.gap: A MEASUREMENT OF THE CURRENT CHAIN AND OF LIGHTWEIGHT TAGS. The tags in this repository are lightweight refs, so the mapping they carry is exactly a name-to-OID pair and is therefore derivable. An annotated or signed tag carries a tag OBJECT with a message, a tagger and possibly a signature, none of which is derivable from the receipt chain — so this result does not extend to a future annotated tag, and FAC-TAG-DERIVED states that scope explicitly.
attrs.prior_art: Fable 5 R8.3 research witness receipt-identity-walk.mjs; GPT-5.6 adjudication §1 (independent reproduction).
attrs.review_focus: The measurement is re-run at every head, so it grows with the chain. Does it still hold at INV-R9, whose parent is INV-R8.3 and whose content came partly from a lane that is not on the chain at all?
attrs.statement: Measured: every promoted revision name and OID on the post-recovery receipt chain reconstructs from a single canonical-ref read plus committed receipts, and the current canonical lightweight tag mappings agree with the reconstruction.
